description: Search Swiss parliamentary business by title substring, published submitter label, type, current status, submission session, inclusive submission dates, or committee role. Use chparl_list_reference to resolve codes and chparl_get_business to read a returned businessId. Follow nextCursor with unchanged filters; newest canonical business IDs appear first. Author searches omit the business total. Committee searches page role candidates and may return short pages without a distinct business total. Metadata labels remain in de, fr, or it without translation fallback.

author.description: Substring of the published submitter label, not every co-signatory.

committeeId.description: Committee number from chparl_list_reference topic committees; matches any published committee role.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous call with identical filters; omit to start.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it.

limit.description: Page request, default 20; clamped to 100. Committee pages count candidate roles, and byte fitting may return fewer businesses.

query.description: One title substring, preserving punctuation and diacritics.

sessionId.description: Submission session ID from chparl_list_reference topic sessions.

statusId.description: Current status code from chparl_list_reference topic statuses.

typeId.description: Business type code from chparl_list_reference topic business_types.

name: chparl_search_business

businesses.description: Distinct complete business summaries on this page.

items.description: One parliamentary business, preserving sparse source metadata.

businessId.description: Canonical Business.ID as a decimal string.

metadataLanguage.description: Requested metadata row language; no text translation is implied.

sourceUrl.description: Exact HTTPS OData entity URL for this metadata row.

statusDate.description: Current status date with source timezone semantics.

statusId.description: Current business status code, including unknown source codes.

submittedBy.description: Published submitter label; not an exhaustive signatory list.

effectiveFilters.description: Effective business discovery filters and defaults.

cursor.description: Validated cursor supplied for this page.

limit.description: Effective role-candidate or business row limit.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective business or role-candidate limit after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incompatible_fields`: submittedFrom is after submittedTo. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is malformed, unsupported, or belongs to different filters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Continue after the smallest delivered business ID using identical filters.

notice.description: Combined clamp, short-page, size-fitting, or empty-result guidance.

provenance.description: Attribution, publication status, and source download dates.

officialPublication.description: This server is an unofficial reproduction of the source.

sources.description: Every HTTP response contributing data, or each static source snapshot.

items.description: A source used to produce this result.

retrievedAt.description: Actual UTC download timestamp, or the date of a static source snapshot.

url.description: HTTPS source response or official snapshot document URL.

totalCount.description: Original-filter business total, available only without author or committee filters.

title: Chparl Search Business
